TERMS & CONDITIONS
IMPORTANT INSTRUCTIONS
HOW TO USE
STORE LOCATOR
Mobile Postpaid - Bill Payment Terms & Conditions
1. This is a Mobile Postpaid Recharge GV (Gift Voucher)/e-Pay that will be accepted on the website: www.gyftr.com/loyaltylifecycle/bills-utilities/mobile-postpaid.
2. GV/e-Pay is valid only for services and billers available on https://www.gyftr.com/loyaltylifecycle/bills-utilities and linked portals.
3. The person who has the GV/e-Pay is deemed to be the beneficiary.
4. Some billers take up to 3 business days to accept the payment after the transaction is completed on GyFTR.com.
5. If the payment has not been accepted after 3 business days, the transaction will be cancelled and a refund will be processed to the original payment method.
6. Refunds for payments made may take up to 5 business days.
7. The GV can be converted into e-Pay as per the holder's convenience.
8. The GV/e-Pay balance cannot be transferred to another e-Pay account, exchanged for cash, or converted into any other form of currency.
9. The e-Pay balance must be linked to the registered mobile number.
10. After conversion into e-Pay balance, this GV is valid for partial redemption. The balance remains in the e-Pay balance and can be used for multiple transactions within the validity period.
11. The GV/e-Pay CANNOT be revalidated once expired or canceled under any circumstances.
12. GyFTR is not responsible if the GV/e-Pay is lost, stolen, or used without permission.
13. If GV/e-Pay gets blocked on account of a technical issue, it will be enabled within 72 hours.
14. Any dispute should be referred to the company from which the GV/e-Pay has been received, and the company's decision shall be final.
15. GyFTR reserves the right to withdraw, modify, cancel, or change the offer at any point without prior notice and at its sole discretion.
16. GV/e-Pay is non-refundable, non-transferable, and cannot be exchanged for cash. No credit note or refund will be issued for partially used or unused balances.
17. Payments are processed through Bharat Bill Payment System (BBPS). Service is valid only for BBPS-listed billers and may not be available for all providers. Availability is not guaranteed for every operator, board, or bank.
18. Customers must enter accurate bill details (Account Number, Consumer ID, Mobile Number, etc.). Payments failing due to incorrect details are non-refundable. In case of technical failure after debit, the amount will be credited back to the e-Pay wallet.
19. If the bill amount exceeds GV/e-Pay value, the remaining balance must be paid by other available payment methods.
20. Customers are responsible for timely bill payments. The company is not liable for any late payment charges, penalties, or disconnection due to delayed or failed payments.
21. Customers must safeguard their GV/e-Pay. The company is not liable for misuse, loss, or unauthorized redemption once issued. Fraudulent activity will be investigated per regulatory guidelines.
22. Customer information for bill payment is processed in compliance with RBI/NPCI/BBPS guidelines and will not be misused or shared beyond regulatory needs.
23. Services may be unavailable due to uncontrollable events (system downtime, natural calamities, regulatory restrictions). The company is not liable for such unavailability.
24. All disputes are subject to the jurisdiction of courts in India.
25. For any queries or issues related to GV/e-Pay, kindly raise a request at www.gvhelpdesk.com.

9. Up to 3 GV/GCs can be combined and used in a single transaction. If 3 GV/GCs are used, the value of the third GV/GC must meet or exceed the remainder payment amount; otherwise, only 2 GV/GCs can be used along with another mode of payment.
10. Multiple GV/GCs can be added to the Air India Wallet at giftcards.airindia.com/en-in/wallet/login. Once added, the GV/GC balance is merged with the Wallet, and the original GV/GC is no longer required for redemption.

4. The GV/GC can be clubbed with existing offers.
5. The GV/GC may be redeemed towards spends on rooms, food and beverages, spa, other services, and applicable taxes at Taj, SeleQtions, Gateway, Vivanta hotels, and Ama Trails & Stays in India.
6. The GV/GC cannot be used for retail spends at third-party outlets, business centre equipment hire, hired services from third-party sources, or expenses of a personal nature for which a payout is raised, such as medicines or repairs of personal items. The GV/GC is also not valid at The Claridges, Tree of Life Resorts, and Ginger Hotels.
7. The GV/GC can also be redeemed for prepaid room reservations for hotels in India through Taj Reservations Worldwide.
8. Multiple transactions can be performed using the GV/GC until the GV/GC value is exhausted.
9. If the purchase value exceeds the GV/GC value, the differential amount may be loaded on the GV/GC or paid at the point of sale through cash or an accepted credit/debit card at the time of purchase.

11. For prepaid room reservations through Taj Reservations Worldwide, the GV/GC number and PIN must be quoted while making the reservation. The entire amount must be paid through the GV/GC to secure the reservation. In case the GV/GC balance is less than the due amount, the GV/GC may be reloaded before processing the reservation. Standard cancellation policies shall apply. For eligible refunds arising from cancellations, customers must contact Taj Reservations Worldwide.

15. Redemption of the GV/GC by its bearer shall be considered a valid discharge of the Company’s liabilities in respect of the GV/GC.

17. Any further dispute related to the GV/GC shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts at Mumbai.
18. The GV/GC is subject to applicable laws. The Company, purchaser, and GV/GC bearer shall comply with all applicable laws promulgated by any statutory, judicial, or competent authority from time to time.

maximize:michael-kors-luxe.terms:
Terms & Conditions
These Terms & Conditions apply to the electronic version of the Luxe Gift Card.
The Luxe Gift Card is issued by Pine Labs Limited (formerly Pine Labs Private Limited) and is valid for 12 months from the date of purchase.
The Luxe Gift Card can be redeemed across 45+ participating brands in India. For store locations, visit: https://www.luxegiftcard.com/brands#store_location
The Luxe Gift Card is not redeemable at airport stores.
The Gift Card can also be redeemed online at the brand websites
The Luxe Gift Card is valid for one-time use only until expiry. If the purchase value exceeds the Gift Card value, the balance amount must be paid by the customer. No refund or credit note will be issued for any unused balance.
Users are advised to protect the Gift Card details. RBL Bank or Pine Labs shall not be liable in case of loss, theft, or misuse of the Gift Card or PIN. The Gift Card will not be replaced or refunded in such cases.
Multiple Luxe Gift Cards can be used in a single transaction.
Once issued, the Luxe Gift Card cannot be cancelled or blocked.
The Gift Card can be redeemed only on full-priced merchandise and is not applicable on discounted items unless specified otherwise.
To activate the Gift Card, send an SMS in the format: ACT <16-digit card number><6-digit PIN> to 9704200300
Alternatively, activation can be done via the portal: https://bit.ly/4072sdb
For balance enquiry and validity, SMS the 16-digit card number to 9704200300 or visit any participating merchant location.
For complete Terms & Conditions, participating brands, and store locations, visit: https://www.luxegiftcard.com
For bulk enquiries or support, contact: info@luxegiftcard.com
Users can change the SMS transaction alert language by writing to gcsupport.woohoo@pinelabs.com , mentioning the registered mobile number and preferred language (Hindi, Telugu, Tamil, Kannada, Marathi, Bengali, Gujarati, Odia, Punjabi, Malayalam, Assamese).
Pine Labs may take up to 15 working days to update the language preference. Once updated, all future SMS alerts for the Luxe Gift Card will be sent in the selected language.
Close
maximize:michael-kors-luxe.instructions:
How To Redeem
Redeem your Luxe Gift Card at any participating brand by providing the digital gift card.
An OTP will be sent to your registered mobile number at the time of redemption.
Use your Luxe Gift Card and OTP to complete redemption.
To activate, SMS ACT <16-digit Card Number> <6-digit PIN> to 9704200300.
For balance and validity, SMS BAL <16-digit Card Number> to 9704200300.
Close

Go to Account → Claim Gift Card.
Enter your Gift Voucher Code and tap Claim Gift Card to add the balance to your LUZO Wallet.
